title: Read the IA range a kit release works with
summary: A kit's release row may now name `works`, the range of IA versions (`@inventarch/cli`) the release works with, beside `cli`, the version that packed it. The method resolver reads a kit whose latest release names `works` with every reader the range admits and refuses any other with IA-CORE-CLI-UNSUPPORTED, so a new IA release inside the range needs no new kit release. A `works` that is not a SemVer range admitting some release, one that only a prerelease satisfies included, refuses IA-CORE-KIT. A release without `works` keeps the earlier packed-major rule.
